1432-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1432-3469-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

5078-6089-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
5078-6089-7693.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

225-751-3314-3756.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-3314-3756.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4399-4770-6097-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6097-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

413-443-1263-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Magus of the Bridge and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

1849-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1849-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1849-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

333-3967-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-3967-7424.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-4460.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4508-5184-5880-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1659-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1651-1863-3875-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-3875-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1863-3875-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

129-2464-5137.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
129-2464-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-2464-5137.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2438-2866-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2854-4316-4574-4708.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4316-4574-4708.description:
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1987-2468-3094-5139.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding {U}{U}
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Relic of Sauron and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

2304-5940-6494.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{R} plus the mana needed to cast the additional instant/sorcery
2304-5940-6494.notablePrerequisites:
You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
2304-5940-6494.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, triggering Arcane Bombardment.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {R}{R} and then choosing to pay an additional {1} to select its first mode, copying the Arcane Bombardment trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Arcane Bombardment trigger, exiling Return the Favor from your graveyard and then copying Return the Favor, Prismari Command and all other cards exiled by Arcane Bombardment, and allowing you to cast those copies without paying their mana costs.
As you cast the Return the Favor copy, choose to pay an additional {1} to select its first mode, targeting the Arcane Bombardment trigger.
Resolve the copy of Prismari Command, creating a Treasure token and choosing any other mode.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the copy of Return the Favor, copying the Arcane Bombardment trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

647-3204-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
647-3204-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

804-2533-4681-5256.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

2034-5003-6199.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice, adding {C}{C}.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Marionette Apprentice from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Marionette Apprentice triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3966-4971-6033.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3966-4971-6033.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

957-1987-3277-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-3277-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

1753-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1722-2034-2999-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-2999-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1972-3090-4691.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

1636-2034-3862-4937.notablePrerequisites:
Lumengrid Augur does not have summoning sickness.
You do not control an Army.
1636-2034-3862-4937.description:
Activate Lumengrid Augur by paying {1} and tapping it, causing target opponent to loot.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Orc Army enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1703-2792-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1703-2792-4050.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding one mana of any color.
Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Great Whale.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

738-4733-5004-5256.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Altar of Dementia.
Cathodion and Dictate of Erebos trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Dictate of Erebos's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
